Errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again, and tell an administrator if it keeps happening.
Errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.NOT_FOUND: That record no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
Errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
Errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not allow this action.
Errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some details are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
Errors.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: The server had a problem completing that. Nothing was changed.
Errors.API_ERROR: That request could not be completed.
Errors.AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password do not match.
Errors.ADMIN_MFA_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
Errors.ADMIN_MFA_INVALID: That code is not valid. Codes expire after 30 seconds, and each recovery code works once.
Errors.ADMIN_MFA_NOT_ENROLLED: Set up two-factor authentication before using the admin portal.
Errors.ADMIN_SUDO_REQUIRED: Confirm it is you before continuing with this action.
Errors.ADMIN_TOKEN_TYPE_INVALID: This session belongs to the mobile app and cannot be used here. Please sign in to the admin portal.
Errors.ADMIN_SELF_MODIFICATION: You cannot change your own role or deactivate your own account.
Errors.ADMIN_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: This is the last super admin. Promote someone else first.
Errors.USER_ALREADY_BANNED: This user is already banned. Nothing was changed.
Errors.USER_NOT_BANNED: This user has no active ban to lift.
Errors.USER_ANONYMISED: This account has passed its grace period and its details have been erased, so it cannot be restored.
Errors.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: That export is too large. Narrow the filter and try again.
Errors.BULK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many users selected. Choose 500 or fewer.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
